g.text: OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR - HAZID STUDY DRAWING
METHANOL CONVERTER VER 1 - R-201 SYNTHESIS LOOP
1. Gas flows in kNm3/h; liquid in t/h; T in °C; P in bar g. Design point of the simulator.
2. Stream numbers 1-12 as in the Process tab stream table; others carry no data.
3. Let-down drum, reformer fuel and flare are outside the battery limit.
4. PSV-201 (set 88 bar g) protects the loop and relieves to flare; HV-205 is the manual blowdown.
